scientific_integrity: A single model-reviewed theorem about two monochromatic tempered waves and the linear Hermitian lift; not a global nonlinear phase-noise estimate or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only two symmetric frequency bins, a fixed integral-normalized Gaussian and the specified Hilbert--Schmidt / normalized beat-period L2 norms
The monochromatic waves are tempered, not L2(R); the Gaussian STFT integral is still absolutely convergent.
Not an optimization over arbitrary asymmetric bins, window shapes, or broadband signals.
Exact priority outside inspected literature remains uncertain.
title: A sharp two-regime Gaussian frequency-bin design for lifted two-tone spectrograms
